objects.definition:
enum Upnp_EventType_e
{
	/*
	 * Control callbacks
	 */

	/*! Received by a device when a control point issues a control
	 * request.  The \b Event parameter contains a pointer to a \b
	 * UpnpActionRequest structure containing the action.  The application
	 * stores the results of the action in this structure. */
	UPNP_CONTROL_ACTION_REQUEST,

	/*! A \b UpnpSendActionAsync call completed. The \b Event
	 * parameter contains a pointer to a \b UpnpActionComplete structure
	 * with the results of the action.  */
	UPNP_CONTROL_ACTION_COMPLETE,

	/*! Received by a device when a query for a single service variable
	 * arrives.  The \b Event parameter contains a pointer to a \b
	 * UpnpStateVarRequest structure containing the name of the variable
	 * and value.  */
	UPNP_CONTROL_GET_VAR_REQUEST,

	/*! A \b UpnpGetServiceVarStatus call completed. The \b Event
	 * parameter contains a pointer to a \b UpnpStateVarComplete structure
	 * containing the value for the variable.  */
	UPNP_CONTROL_GET_VAR_COMPLETE,

	/*
	 * Discovery callbacks
	 */

	/*! Received by a control point when a new device or service is
	 * available. The \b Event parameter contains a pointer to a \b
	 * UpnpDiscovery structure with the information about the device
	 * or service.  */
	UPNP_DISCOVERY_ADVERTISEMENT_ALIVE,

	/*! Received by a control point when a device or service shuts down. The
	 * \b Event parameter contains a pointer to a \b UpnpDiscovery structure
	 * containing the information about the device or service.  */
	UPNP_DISCOVERY_ADVERTISEMENT_BYEBYE,

	/*! Received by a control point when a matching device or service
	 * responds. The \b Event parameter contains a pointer to a \b
	 * UpnpDiscovery structure containing the information about
	 * the reply to the search request.  */
	UPNP_DISCOVERY_SEARCH_RESULT,

	/*! Received by a control point when the search timeout expires.  The
	 * SDK generates no more callbacks for this search after this
	 * event.  The \b Event parameter is \c NULL.  */
	UPNP_DISCOVERY_SEARCH_TIMEOUT,

	/*
	 * Eventing callbacks
	 */

	/*! Received by a device when a subscription arrives.
	 * The \b Event parameter contains a pointer to a \b
	 * UpnpSubscriptionRequest structure.  At this point, the
	 * subscription has already been accepted.  \b UpnpAcceptSubscription
	 * needs to be called to confirm the subscription and transmit the
	 * initial state table.  This can be done during this callback.  The SDK
	 * generates no events for a subscription unless the device
	 * application calls \b UpnpAcceptSubscription.
	 */
	UPNP_EVENT_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUEST,

	/*! Received by a control point when an event arrives. The \b
	 * Event parameter contains a \b UpnpEvent structure
	 * with the information about the event.  */
	UPNP_EVENT_RECEIVED,

	/*! A \b UpnpRenewSubscriptionAsync call completed. The status of
	 * the renewal is in the \b Event parameter as a \b
	 * Upnp_Event_Subscription structure.  */
	UPNP_EVENT_RENEWAL_COMPLETE,

	/*! A \b UpnpSubscribeAsync call completed. The status of the
	 * subscription is in the \b Event parameter as a \b
	 * Upnp_Event_Subscription structure.  */
	UPNP_EVENT_SUBSCRIBE_COMPLETE,

	/*! A \b UpnpUnSubscribeAsync call completed. The status of the
	 * subscription is in the \b Event parameter as a \b
	 * UpnpEventSubscribe structure.  */
	UPNP_EVENT_UNSUBSCRIBE_COMPLETE,

	/*! The auto-renewal of a client subscription failed.
	 * The \b Event parameter is a \b UpnpEventSubscribe structure
	 * with the error code set appropriately. The subscription is no longer
	 * valid. */
	UPNP_EVENT_AUTORENEWAL_FAILED,

	/*! A client subscription has expired. This will only occur
	 * if auto-renewal of subscriptions is disabled.
	 * The \b Event parameter is a \b UpnpEventSubscribe
	 * structure. The subscription is no longer valid. */
	UPNP_EVENT_SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED
};

typedef enum Upnp_EventType_e Upnp_EventType;
objects.description: Enumeration of all UPnP SDK callback reasons. Used to interpret the type of the void* Event payload delivered to application callbacks.
Function pointer type for application callbacks: takes an event type, an event payload pointer (type depends on EventType), and a user cookie; returns int (currently ignored by SDK).

Opaque handle to a collection of extra HTTP-style headers used by the UPnP stack. The concrete struct s_UpnpExtraHeaders is not defined in this header; consumers manipulate it via the provided constructor, destructor, copy, assignment, and field-accessor functions. Internally it appears to hold a list node link, a header name, a header value, and a response string, but exact layout is intentionally hidden.

Opaque handle to a file/info record used by the UPnP stack. The concrete struct s_UpnpFileInfo is not defined in this header; users interact with it via the provided constructor, destructor, copy, assignment, and field accessor functions. Internally it appears to hold file length, last-modified time, directory/readable flags, content type, a list of extra headers, controller point IP address, and an OS string.

Opaque handle to an UpnpDiscovery object representing the result/metadata of a UPnP SSDP discovery event (e.g., device/service advertisement). The struct is forward-declared and not defined in this header, indicating it is an opaque type managed via the provided API. Internal layout is hidden.

Incomplete/forward declaration of the concrete struct underlying UpnpDiscovery. It is intentionally opaque; consumers should use the UpnpDiscovery typedef and the provided API functions. No fields are visible here.

Opaque event object for UPnP state variable change notifications. The actual struct layout is hidden (forward-declared only); it is managed via the provided constructor/destructor and accessor functions. It encapsulates an event key (int), a set of changed variables (IXML_Document*), and a subscription ID (UpnpString). Exact lifetime/ownership rules for contained pointers should be inferred from the API: setters exist to assign values, and getters expose them. Internal details are unknown due to lack of a full definition in this header.

Opaque handle representing an event subscription in the UPnP library. The concrete struct s_UpnpEventSubscribe is intentionally not defined in this header (forward-declared only). It is managed via provided constructor/destructor and accessor APIs. Holds fields such as error code, timeout, subscription ID (SID), and publisher URL (both as UpnpString). Exact layout is private/unknown from this header.

Incomplete struct type for the opaque UpnpEventSubscribe object. The full definition is not present in this header and resides elsewhere. Use only through the UpnpEventSubscribe typedef and the provided API.

Opaque request object representing a UPnP GetStateVariable request/response context. The concrete struct s_UpnpStateVarRequest is not defined in this header, making this an incomplete type intended to be managed via the provided API (construct, destroy, copy/assign, and field accessors for error code/string, socket, device UDN, service ID, state variable name, control point address, and current value). Internal layout is hidden.

Opaque handle to a "state variable complete" object used in the UPnP API. The actual struct layout is intentionally hidden (incomplete type here); it is managed via the provided constructor, destructor, copy, assignment, and field accessors for error code, control URL, state variable name, and current value.

Opaque handle representing a UPnP action request object. The concrete struct s_UpnpActionRequest is intentionally not exposed here; the type is managed via the provided constructor, destructor, copy, assignment, and a set of getters/setters for its properties (error code/string, socket, action name, device UDN, service ID, XML action request/result/soap header documents, controller IP address, and OS string). Details of internal layout are unknown in this header.

Opaque handle representing the result of a completed UPnP action invocation. The struct is forward-declared only in this header and defined elsewhere, indicating it is an opaque type managed via the provided constructor/destructor and accessor APIs. It encapsulates the error code, control URL (UpnpString), the original action request (IXML_Document), and the action result (IXML_Document). Internal layout is unknown from this header.

Opaque handle to a subscription request in the UPnP stack. The concrete struct s_UpnpSubscriptionRequest is not defined in this header, indicating clients use it as an opaque type managed via the provided constructor, destructor, copy, assign, and field accessors/mutators. It encapsulates ServiceId, UDN, and SID strings for a subscription operation. Internal layout is unknown from this header.

No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. The file only declares/defines functions for debugging (IxmlPrintf, printNodes) and references external types such as IXML_Node from other headers.

functions.name: UpnpString_new
functions.description: Allocates and constructs a new UpnpString object managed by the libupnp string API. Use this to obtain an empty, valid UpnpString instance for subsequent operations, and release it with UpnpString_delete when done.
requirements: Must be paired with UpnpString_delete to avoid memory leaks.
Returned pointer must be checked by the caller before use; allocation failure handling is required (may return NULL).

functions.name: UpnpString_delete
functions.description: Destroys and frees an UpnpString previously created (e.g., by UpnpString_new or UpnpString_dup). After this call, the object must not be used.
requirements: p must be a valid pointer to an UpnpString allocated by this API.
p must not be used after this call (dangling pointer).
Behavior for p == NULL is unspecified; pass only valid, non-NULL pointers.

functions.name: UpnpString_dup
functions.description: Creates a new, independently allocated copy of the given UpnpString. Use when a deep copy of the string object is required. The returned object must be freed with UpnpString_delete.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to an existing UpnpString.
Caller must free the returned object with UpnpString_delete.
Caller must check the return value for allocation failure (may be NULL).

functions.name: UpnpString_assign
functions.description: Assigns the contents of q to p, replacing p’s current contents. Acts as an assignment operator for the UpnpString type.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString to receive the assignment.
q must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString as the source.

functions.name: UpnpString_get_Length
functions.description: Returns the current length (number of characters) of the UpnpString.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.

functions.name: UpnpString_set_Length
functions.description: Truncates the string to at most n characters; if the current length is less than or equal to n, the string is left unchanged. Does not extend or pad the string.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
n is the requested maximum length (size_t). No effect if current length <= n.

functions.name: UpnpString_get_String
functions.description: Returns a const char* view of the string’s internal buffer for read-only access.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
The returned pointer is const; the caller must not modify the memory it points to.
Whether the returned pointer can be NULL or its lifetime semantics are not documented; treat as unknown.

functions.name: UpnpString_set_String
functions.description: Sets the UpnpString’s contents by copying from a C string s.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
s should be a valid, non-NULL NUL-terminated C string. Behavior for s == NULL is unspecified.
Function returns an int; specific success/failure conventions are not documented and should be treated as unknown. Caller must handle possible error codes.

functions.name: UpnpString_set_StringN
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpString_set_StringN(UpnpString *p, const char *s, size_t n);
functions.description: Sets the UpnpString’s contents by copying at most n characters from C string s.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
s should be a valid, non-NULL pointer to readable memory containing at least min(strlen(s), n) bytes.
n specifies the maximum number of characters to copy (size_t).
Function returns an int; specific success/failure conventions are not documented and should be treated as unknown. Caller must handle possible error codes.

functions.name: UpnpString_clear
functions.description: Clears the string, setting its length to zero.
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.

functions.name: UpnpString_cmp
functions.description: Performs a case-sensitive comparison of two UpnpString objects; returns the result of strcmp-style ordering (negative if p<q, zero if equal, positive if p>q).
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
q must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
Return value follows strcmp semantics as documented.

functions.name: UpnpString_casecmp
functions.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two UpnpString objects; returns the result of strcasecmp-style ordering (negative, zero, or positive).
requirements: p must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
q must be a valid, non-NULL UpnpString.
Return value follows strcasecmp semantics as documented.

functions.name: UpnpListInit
functions.description: Initialize an intrusive UpnpListHead as an empty list anchor. Intended to be called before any other list operations. Implementation performs no allocation and only manipulates link pointers.
requirements: list must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid UpnpListHead used as the list anchor.
list should be initialized with UpnpListInit before using UpnpListBegin/End/Next/Insert/Erase.
Caller is responsible for allocating and managing the lifetime of the list anchor and any elements (no allocation/deallocation is performed by this API).

functions.name: UpnpListBegin
functions.description: Return an iterator to the first element in the list, or the end iterator if the list is empty. Useful for starting forward iteration.
requirements: list must be a non-NULL pointer to a previously initialized UpnpListHead (via UpnpListInit).
Returned iterator equals UpnpListEnd(list) when the list is empty.

functions.name: UpnpListEnd
functions.description: Return the end-of-list sentinel iterator for the given list. This iterator does not refer to an element and is used as the termination condition in iterations.
requirements: list must be a non-NULL pointer to a previously initialized UpnpListHead (via UpnpListInit).
The returned iterator is a sentinel and must not be treated as a dereferenceable element.

functions.name: UpnpListNext
functions.description: Return an iterator to the element following pos within list, or the end iterator if pos was the last element. Supports forward iteration.
requirements: list must be a non-NULL pointer to a previously initialized UpnpListHead (via UpnpListInit).
pos must be a valid iterator obtained from this list (either an element iterator or UpnpListEnd(list)).
If pos is UpnpListEnd(list), the returned iterator is also UpnpListEnd(list).

functions.name: UpnpListInsert
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC UpnpListIter UpnpListInsert(UpnpListHead *list, UpnpListIter pos, UpnpListHead *elt);
functions.description: Insert the element elt into list immediately before iterator pos and return an iterator to the inserted element. Does not allocate memory; it only re-links the intrusive node.
requirements: list must be a non-NULL pointer to a previously initialized UpnpListHead (via UpnpListInit).
pos must be a valid iterator in this list (including UpnpListEnd(list) to append at the end).
elt must be a non-NULL pointer to an UpnpListHead that is ready to be linked (i.e., represents an element).
Caller must ensure elt is not currently linked into any list to avoid corrupting existing lists (intrusive list invariant).
Caller is responsible for the lifetime of elt; the API does not copy or allocate elements.

functions.name: UpnpListErase
functions.description: Remove the element at iterator pos from list and return an iterator to the next element, or the end iterator if the removed element was the last. Only pointer links are updated; no memory is freed.
requirements: list must be a non-NULL pointer to a previously initialized UpnpListHead (via UpnpListInit).
pos must be a valid iterator referring to an actual element in this list (not the end sentinel).
The returned iterator is valid for continued iteration and may equal UpnpListEnd(list) if the erased element was the last.
Caller remains responsible for deallocating or reusing the removed element; the API does not free memory.

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_new
functions.description: Constructs and returns a new UpnpExtraHeaders object representing an extra HTTP/UPnP header entry (name/value and related list linkage). Use this to allocate a fresh instance before setting fields like name, value, or linking into a list.
requirements: Caller must check the return value for NULL to detect allocation failure.
The returned object must be released with UpnpExtraHeaders_delete when no longer needed.
The object is not valid for use after it has been deleted.

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_delete
functions.description: Destroys and frees an UpnpExtraHeaders object and any resources it owns.
requirements: Parameter p must be a valid pointer to an UpnpExtraHeaders previously created by UpnpExtraHeaders_new or UpnpExtraHeaders_dup (or otherwise properly initialized).
Do not use p after calling this function.
If the object has been inserted into a list, ensure it is not in use elsewhere before deleting (removal requirements are unknown; avoid deleting while still linked).

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_dup
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of an existing UpnpExtraHeaders object.
requirements: Parameter p must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid, initialized UpnpExtraHeaders.
Caller must check the return value for NULL to detect allocation or copy failure.
The returned copy must be freed with UpnpExtraHeaders_delete.

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_assign
functions.description: Assigns/copies the contents of q into p, replacing p’s current contents. Intended to make p a copy of q without reallocating p.
requirements: Parameters p and q must be non-NULL and refer to valid, initialized UpnpExtraHeaders objects.
Caller must check the returned int status to determine success or failure (specific codes are not documented here).
If p is part of a list or referenced elsewhere, be aware its internal state (name/value/node) may change as a result of assignment; external invariants must be managed by the caller.

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_get_node
functions.description: Returns a const pointer to the internal list node used to link this UpnpExtraHeaders into a list of headers.
requirements: Parameter p must be a non-NULL pointer to a valid UpnpExtraHeaders.
The returned pointer must not be modified by the caller.
Do not use the returned pointer after p is deleted.

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_set_node
functions.description: Sets the internal list node of the UpnpExtraHeaders object. Typically used by internal list management; external callers rarely need this.
requirements: Parameters p and q must be valid pointers.
Caller must check the returned int status to determine success or failure.
The lifetime/ownership relationship for q is not documented; avoid passing a pointer that will become invalid while p uses it.
Misuse can corrupt list linkage; ensure list invariants are respected.

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_add_to_list_node
functions.description: Adds the UpnpExtraHeaders' internal node to the provided list head, linking this header into a list.
requirements: Parameters p and head must be non-NULL and valid.
head must be an initialized UpnpListHead representing a list.
The UpnpExtraHeaders must remain alive and not be deleted while it is linked in the list.
Do not add the same node multiple times to a list without removing it first (list corruption risk).

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_get_name

Do not use the returned pointer after p is deleted or the name is modified/cleared.

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_set_name

functions.name: UpnpExtraHeaders_get_name_Length

functions.name: UpnpInit2
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpInit2(const char *IfName, unsigned short DestPort);
functions.description: Initialize the UPnP SDK once per process for IPv4/IPv6, optionally binding to a specific interface name and port. Must be called before any other SDK function. Returns 0 on success or an error code.
requirements: Must be called exactly once per process before using any other API.
IfName may be NULL to auto-select a suitable interface; otherwise must name an interface with a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
DestPort may be 0 to auto-select a free port; otherwise the chosen port must be available.
Subsequent calls after successful initialization return UPNP_E_INIT.
Call UpnpFinish() to terminate/cleanup before reinitializing.

functions.name: UpnpInitSslContext
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpInitSslContext(int initOpenSslLib, const SSL_METHOD *sslMethod);

requirements: Only available when the library is compiled with UPNP_ENABLE_OPEN_SSL; otherwise this function is not present.
If initOpenSslLib is 1, the application delegates OpenSSL global initialization to the SDK; otherwise the application must have initialized OpenSSL itself.
sslMethod must point to a valid SSL_METHOD as per OpenSSL documentation.

functions.name: UpnpFinish
functions.description: Terminate the UPnP SDK, unregistering client/device, stopping threads/servers, and releasing resources. Should be the last API call.
requirements: Must be called once after successful UpnpInit2() and after unregistering clients/devices if applicable.
Calling without a prior successful UpnpInit2() or calling more than once returns UPNP_E_FINISH.
No API calls should be made after a successful UpnpFinish until reinitialized.

functions.name: UpnpRegisterRootDevice
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpRegisterRootDevice(const char *DescUrl, Upnp_FunPtr Callback, const void *Cookie, UpnpDevice_Handle *Hnd);
functions.description: Register a UPnP device with a description document URL. On success returns a device handle and enables device-side callbacks.
requirements: Requires successful UpnpInit2().
DescUrl must be a valid, reachable URL to a device description.
Callback must be a valid function pointer; Hnd must be a valid output pointer.
Cookie is an opaque user pointer returned in callbacks; may be NULL.
Only one device may be registered per process; otherwise UPNP_E_ALREADY_REGISTERED.

functions.name: UpnpRegisterRootDevice2
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpRegisterRootDevice2(Upnp_DescType descriptionType, const char *description, size_t bufferLen, int config_baseURL, Upnp_FunPtr Fun, const void *Cookie, UpnpDevice_Handle *Hnd);
functions.description: Register a UPnP device using a description provided as URL, filename, or in-memory XML buffer. Optionally configures URLBase and serves the description via the internal web server.
requirements: Requires successful UpnpInit2().
descriptionType must be one of UPNPREG_URL_DESC, UPNPREG_FILENAME_DESC, or UPNPREG_BUF_DESC.
description must be non-NULL and appropriate to descriptionType; for BUF_DESC, bufferLen must equal the buffer length; otherwise bufferLen is ignored.
If config_baseURL != 0, the internal web server must be compiled in and activated via UpnpSetWebServerRootDir() before calling.
Fun, Hnd must be valid pointers; Cookie may be NULL.
URL or file must typically have .xml extension; otherwise UPNP_E_EXT_NOT_XML may be returned.
Only one device may be registered per process.

requirements: Requires successful UpnpInit2().
DescUrl must be a valid URL; Callback and Hnd must be valid pointers.
AddressFamily must be AF_INET (IPv4) or AF_INET6 (IPv6).
Cookie may be NULL.
Only one device may be registered per process.

functions.name: UpnpRegisterRootDevice4

functions.description: Register a UPnP device for a specific address family with an additional legacy description URL to be returned to legacy control points.
requirements: Requires successful UpnpInit2().
DescUrl and LowerDescUrl must be valid URLs; Callback and Hnd must be valid pointers.
AddressFamily must be AF_INET or AF_INET6.
Cookie may be NULL.
Only one device may be registered per process.

functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSearchAsync(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, int Mx, const char *TTarget_constarget_const, const void *Cookie_const);
functions.description: Asynchronously issue an SSDP M-SEARCH for devices/services matching the search target. Results arrive via the client's registered callback.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
Mx is the maximum wait in seconds; values are clamped to MIN_SEARCH_TIME..MAX_SEARCH_TIME by the SDK.

Exp is Max-Age in seconds; if <1, SDK uses DEFAULT_MAXAGE; if <= AUTO_ADVERTISEMENT_TIME*2, SDK uses (AUTO_ADVERTISEMENT_TIME+1)*2.

functions.name: UpnpSendAdvertisementLowPower
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSendAdvertisementLowPower(UpnpDevice_Handle Hnd, int Exp, int PowerState, int SleepPeriod, int RegistrationState);
functions.description: Synchronously send SSDP alive advertisements including UPnP Low Power extension fields.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid device handle.
Exp handling follows UpnpSendAdvertisement rules.
PowerState, SleepPeriod, RegistrationState must follow UPnP Low Power specification (exact ranges not specified here).

functions.name: UpnpGetServiceVarStatus
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpGetServiceVarStatus(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *ActionURL, const char *VarName, DOMString *StVarVal);
functions.description: Deprecated: synchronously query the value of a state variable on a service using the eventing variable-query mechanism. On success returns value via StVarVal.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
ActionURL must be a valid service control/event URL.
VarName must be non-NULL.
StVarVal must be a valid output pointer; SDK allocates the string; caller must free with ixmlFreeDOMString.
Positive return values indicate SOAP fault codes; negative values are SDK errors.

functions.name: UpnpGetServiceVarStatusAsync
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpGetServiceVarStatusAsync(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *ActionURL, const char *VarName, Upnp_FunPtr Fun, const void *Cookie);
functions.description: Deprecated: asynchronously query the value of a service variable; completion is delivered via the provided callback.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
ActionURL and VarName must be non-NULL.
Fun must be a valid callback; Cookie may be NULL.

functions.name: UpnpSendAction
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSendAction(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *ActionURL, const char *ServiceType, const char *DevUDN, IXML_Document *Action, IXML_Document **RespNode);
functions.description: Synchronously invoke a UPnP SOAP action on a service and return the response XML document. Positive return values are SOAP fault codes; negative are SDK errors.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
ActionURL and ServiceType must be non-NULL and valid for the target service.
DevUDN must be NULL (ignored by SDK).
Action must point to a valid DOM document representing the SOAP action body.
RespNode must be a valid output pointer; SDK allocates the response document; caller must free it.

functions.name: UpnpSendActionEx
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSendActionEx(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *ActionURL, const char *ServiceType, const char *DevUDN, IXML_Document *Header, IXML_Document *Action, IXML_Document **RespNode);
functions.description: Synchronously invoke a SOAP action with an optional custom SOAP header. Returns response XML via RespNode. Positive return values are SOAP fault codes; negative are SDK errors.
requirements: Same as UpnpSendAction, plus Header may be NULL to omit SOAP headers; otherwise must be a valid DOM document.

functions.name: UpnpSendActionAsync
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSendActionAsync(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *ActionURL, const char *ServiceType, const char *DevUDN, IXML_Document *Action, Upnp_FunPtr Fun, const void *Cookie);
functions.description: Asynchronously invoke a SOAP action; completion and any SOAP fault code are delivered via the registered callback (UPNP_CONTROL_ACTION_COMPLETE).
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
ActionURL and ServiceType must be non-NULL.
DevUDN must be NULL (ignored).
Action must be a valid DOM document.
Fun must be a valid callback; Cookie may be NULL.

functions.name: UpnpSendActionExAsync
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSendActionExAsync(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *ActionURL, const char *ServiceType, const char *DevUDN, IXML_Document *Header, IXML_Document *Action, Upnp_FunPtr Fun, const void *Cookie);
functions.description: Asynchronously invoke a SOAP action with an optional SOAP header; completion via callback.
requirements: Same requirements as UpnpSendActionAsync.
Header may be NULL or a valid DOM document.

functions.name: UpnpAcceptSubscription
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpAcceptSubscription(UpnpDevice_Handle Hnd, const char *DevID, const char *ServID, const char **VarName, const char **NewVal, int cVariables, const Upnp_SID SubsId);
functions.description: Accept a pending GENA subscription request for a service and send the initial event with the provided state variable names and values.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid device handle.
DevID and ServID must refer to a valid service.
VarName and NewVal must be arrays of length cVariables containing variable names and corresponding values; cVariables must be >= 0.
SubsId must be the SID of the subscription being accepted.

functions.name: UpnpAcceptSubscriptionExt
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpAcceptSubscriptionExt(UpnpDevice_Handle Hnd, const char *DevID, const char *ServID, IXML_Document *PropSet, const Upnp_SID SubsId);
functions.description: Accept a pending GENA subscription request using a DOM property set document to specify current state values.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid device handle.
DevID and ServID must refer to a valid service.
PropSet must be a valid DOM property set document per UPnP DA section 4.3.
SubsId must be the SID of the subscription being accepted.

functions.name: UpnpNotify
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpNotify(UpnpDevice_Handle, const char *DevID, const char *ServID, const char **VarName, const char **NewVal, int cVariables);
functions.description: Send a GENA event notification to all subscribers of a service using arrays of variable names and values.
requirements: First parameter must be a valid device handle.
DevID and ServID must identify a valid service.
VarName and NewVal must be arrays of length cVariables; cVariables must be >= 0.

functions.name: UpnpNotifyExt
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpNotifyExt(UpnpDevice_Handle, const char *DevID, const char *ServID, IXML_Document *PropSet);
functions.description: Send a GENA event notification using a DOM property set document instead of arrays.
requirements: First parameter must be a valid device handle.
DevID and ServID must identify a valid service.
PropSet must be a valid property set DOM document.

functions.name: UpnpRenewSubscription
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpRenewSubscription(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, int *TimeOut, const Upnp_SID SubsId);
functions.description: Synchronously renew an existing GENA subscription given its SID; returns the actual timeout via TimeOut.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
TimeOut must be a valid in/out pointer; on input contains requested seconds, on output actual granted seconds.
SubsId must be a valid subscription ID.

functions.name: UpnpRenewSubscriptionAsync
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpRenewSubscriptionAsync(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, int TimeOut, Upnp_SID SubsId, Upnp_FunPtr Fun, const void *Cookie);
functions.description: Asynchronously renew an existing subscription; completion status and actual timeout are returned via the provided callback.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
TimeOut must be >= 0 or equal to UPNP_INFINITE.
SubsId must be a valid SID.
Fun must be a valid callback; Cookie may be NULL.

functions.name: UpnpSetMaxSubscriptions
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSetMaxSubscriptions(UpnpDevice_Handle Hnd, int MaxSubscriptions);
functions.description: Set a per-service cap on the number of accepted subscriptions; existing subscriptions are not dropped when lowering the cap.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid device handle.
MaxSubscriptions is an integer limit; exact min/max unspecified; negative values not indicated as valid in docs.

functions.name: UpnpSetMaxSubscriptionTimeOut
functions.description: Set the maximum time-out value that the device will grant for subscription requests and renewals.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid device handle.
MaxSubscriptionTimeOut must be a non-negative integer number of seconds (docs imply).

functions.name: UpnpSubscribe
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSubscribe(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *PublisherUrl, int *TimeOut, Upnp_SID SubsId);
functions.description: Synchronously subscribe to a service’s event URL; returns the granted timeout via TimeOut and the new SID in SubsId.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
PublisherUrl must be a valid URL to the service’s event subscription endpoint.
TimeOut must be a valid in/out pointer; on input is requested seconds, on output actual granted seconds.
SubsId must be a valid output buffer for the returned SID (Upnp_SID[44]).

functions.name: UpnpSubscribeAsync
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpSubscribeAsync(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const char *PublisherUrl, int TimeOut, Upnp_FunPtr Fun, const void *Cookie);
functions.description: Asynchronously subscribe to a service’s event URL; completion and returned SID/timeout are delivered via the callback.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
PublisherUrl must be a valid URL.
TimeOut is the requested time in seconds.
Fun must be a valid callback; Cookie may be NULL.

functions.name: UpnpUnSubscribe
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpUnSubscribe(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, const Upnp_SID SubsId);
functions.description: Synchronously unsubscribe from a service given its SID.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
SubsId must be a valid subscription ID returned by subscribe.

functions.name: UpnpUnSubscribeAsync
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpUnSubscribeAsync(UpnpClient_Handle Hnd, Upnp_SID SubsId, Upnp_FunPtr Fun, const void *Cookie);
functions.description: Asynchronously unsubscribe from a service; completion is reported via the callback.
requirements: Hnd must be a valid control point handle.
SubsId must be a valid SID.
Fun must be a valid callback; Cookie may be NULL.

functions.name: UpnpDownloadUrlItem
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpDownloadUrlItem(const char *url, char **outBuf, char *contentType);
functions.description: Download the content at the given URL into a single buffer allocated by the SDK, and optionally return the Content-Type header.
requirements: url must be a valid URL.
outBuf must be a valid output pointer; SDK allocates the buffer; caller must free via SDK-specific mechanism (not detailed here).
contentType must be a valid buffer at least LINE_SIZE bytes if provided; receives Content-Type header if present.

functions.name: UpnpOpenHttpGet
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpOpenHttpGet(const char *url, void **handle, char **contentType, int *contentLength, int *httpStatus, int timeout);
functions.description: Initiate an HTTP GET transfer for the given URL and return a connection handle plus response metadata. Subsequent data is read with UpnpReadHttpGet and closed with UpnpCloseHttpGet.
requirements: url must be a valid URL.
handle must be a valid output pointer; SDK allocates a connection token.
contentType and contentLength must be valid output pointers; contentType memory is freed when freeing the handle.
httpStatus must be a valid output pointer to receive the initial HTTP status code.
timeout < 0 means infinite; otherwise a finite wait in milliseconds/seconds as per SDK (units implied seconds).

functions.name: UpnpOpenHttpGetProxy
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpOpenHttpGetProxy(const char *url, const char *proxy_str, void **handle, char **contentType, int *contentLength, int *httpStatus, int timeout);
functions.description: Initiate an HTTP GET through the specified proxy, returning a connection handle and response metadata.
requirements: url must be a valid URL.
proxy_str must be a valid proxy URL.
Other parameter requirements match UpnpOpenHttpGet.
timeout semantics as in UpnpOpenHttpGet.

functions.name: UpnpOpenHttpGetEx
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpOpenHttpGetEx(const char *url, void **handle, char **contentType, int *contentLength, int *httpStatus, int lowRange, int highRange, int timeout);
functions.description: Initiate an HTTP GET for a specific byte range [lowRange, highRange], returning a handle and response metadata.
requirements: url must be valid; handle, contentType, contentLength, httpStatus must be valid output pointers.
lowRange and highRange specify the requested byte range; must be non-negative and lowRange <= highRange (implied by HTTP semantics; not explicitly stated).
timeout semantics as in UpnpOpenHttpGet.

functions.name: UpnpReadHttpGet
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpReadHttpGet(void *handle, char *buf, size_t *size, int timeout);
functions.description: Read a chunk of data from an HTTP GET transfer into buf; size is in/out specifying requested and actual bytes read. Can be canceled by UpnpCancelHttpGet.
requirements: handle must be a valid handle returned by UpnpOpenHttpGet/OpenHttpGetProxy/OpenHttpGetEx.
buf must be a valid buffer; size must be a valid in/out pointer containing available buffer size on input.
timeout < 0 means infinite wait.

functions.name: UpnpHttpGetProgress
functions.description: Retrieve progress information for an ongoing HTTP GET transfer: bytes received and total content length.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP GET handle.
length and total must be valid output pointers.

functions.name: UpnpCancelHttpGet
functions.description: Set the cancel flag for an ongoing HTTP GET transfer represented by handle.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP GET handle currently in progress.

functions.name: UpnpCloseHttpGet
functions.description: Close a previously opened HTTP GET connection and free associated resources.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP GET handle; after success, handle becomes invalid.

functions.name: UpnpOpenHttpPost
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpOpenHttpPost(const char *url, void **handle, const char *contentType, int contentLength, int timeout);
functions.description: Open an HTTP POST connection to the given URL, specifying content type and length; subsequent writes via UpnpWriteHttpPost and finalization via UpnpCloseHttpPost.
requirements: url must be a valid URL.
handle must be a valid output pointer; SDK allocates a connection token.
contentType may be NULL or a valid MIME type string.
contentLength must be the total number of bytes to be sent (non-negative).
timeout < 0 means infinite.

functions.name: UpnpWriteHttpPost
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpWriteHttpPost(void *handle, char *buf, size_t *size, int timeout);
functions.description: Write a chunk of request body bytes to an open HTTP POST connection; size is in/out specifying requested and actually written bytes.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP POST handle.
buf must be a valid buffer; size must be a valid in/out pointer.
timeout < 0 means infinite wait.

functions.name: UpnpCloseHttpPost
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpCloseHttpPost(void *handle, int *httpStatus, int timeout);
functions.description: Finish sending any pending POST data, read the response, close the POST connection, and free resources; returns final HTTP status.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP POST handle.
httpStatus must be a valid output pointer.
timeout < 0 means infinite wait.

functions.name: UpnpOpenHttpConnection
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpOpenHttpConnection(const char *url, void **handle, int timeout);
functions.description: Open a reusable HTTP connection based on the scheme and host from url; subsequent requests are made with UpnpMakeHttpRequest.
requirements: url must be a valid URL containing host and scheme (http/https depending on build).
handle must be a valid output pointer; SDK allocates connection.
timeout < 0 means infinite.

functions.name: UpnpMakeHttpRequest
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpMakeHttpRequest(Upnp_HttpMethod method, const char *url, void *handle, UpnpString *headers, const char *contentType, int contentLength, int timeout);
functions.description: Make an HTTP request over an open connection. Optionally set headers, content type, and content length (or special values for chunked/stream-until-close). Must end the request with UpnpEndHttpRequest before starting another on the same handle.
requirements: handle must be a valid connection returned by UpnpOpenHttpConnection.
method must be a valid Upnp_HttpMethod value.
url should use the same scheme as the opened connection; host may differ when proxying.
headers may be NULL or a valid UpnpString where each header line is CRLF-terminated.
contentType may be NULL; contentLength may be an explicit byte count, or UPNP_USING_CHUNKED, or UPNP_UNTIL_CLOSE.
Must call UpnpEndHttpRequest() to finish the request before issuing another on the same handle.
timeout < 0 means infinite.

functions.name: UpnpWriteHttpRequest
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpWriteHttpRequest(void *handle, char *buf, size_t *size, int timeout);
functions.description: Write request body bytes for a request started with UpnpMakeHttpRequest; call UpnpEndHttpRequest to signal end of body.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP connection with an active request expecting a body.
buf and size must be valid; size is in/out.
timeout < 0 means infinite.

functions.name: UpnpEndHttpRequest
functions.description: Indicate the end of the current HTTP request on a connection created with UpnpOpenHttpConnection.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP connection with a request in progress.
Must be called after UpnpMakeHttpRequest (and any writes) before reading a response or starting a new request.
timeout < 0 means infinite.

functions.name: UpnpGetHttpResponse
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpGetHttpResponse(void *handle, UpnpString *headers, char **contentType, int *contentLength, int *httpStatus, int timeout);
functions.description: Get the response status, headers, content type, and content length for the current request on an open HTTP connection.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP connection with a completed request (UpnpEndHttpRequest called).
headers may be NULL or a valid UpnpString to receive headers.
contentType and contentLength must be valid output pointers if provided; contentType is only valid until the next HTTP API call on this connection.
httpStatus must be a valid output pointer.
timeout < 0 means infinite.

functions.name: UpnpReadHttpResponse
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpReadHttpResponse(void *handle, char *buf, size_t *size, int timeout);
functions.description: Read response body bytes for the current HTTP response; size is in/out specifying requested and actual bytes read.
requirements: handle must be a valid HTTP connection with a response available.
buf must be a valid buffer; size must be a valid in/out pointer.
timeout < 0 means infinite.
Another thread may cancel via UpnpCancelHttpGet, resulting in UPNP_E_CANCELED.

functions.name: UpnpCloseHttpConnection
functions.description: Close a reusable HTTP connection and free resources.
requirements: handle must be a valid connection handle returned by UpnpOpenHttpConnection; after success, handle becomes invalid.

functions.name: UpnpDownloadXmlDoc
functions.description: Download and parse an XML document from the given URL into an IXML_Document allocated by the SDK.
requirements: url must be a valid URL pointing to an XML document.
xmlDoc must be a valid output pointer; caller is responsible for freeing the returned DOM document.

functions.name: UpnpSetWebServerRootDir
functions.description: Set the document root directory for the internal web server and enable it; pass NULL to disable the web server.
requirements: Available only if the internal web server is compiled in.
rootDir must be a valid existing directory path to enable; NULL disables the web server.

functions.name: UpnpVirtualDir_set_GetInfoCallback
functions.description: Register the get-info callback used by the internal web server to query metadata for files in virtual directories.
requirements: Internal web server/virtual directory support must be compiled in.
callback must be a valid function pointer.

functions.name: UpnpVirtualDir_set_OpenCallback
functions.description: Register the open callback used by the web server to open files in virtual directories.
requirements: Internal web server/virtual directory support must be compiled in.
callback must be a valid function pointer returning a valid UpnpWebFileHandle.

functions.name: UpnpVirtualDir_set_ReadCallback
functions.description: Register the read callback used by the web server to read from virtual directory file handles.
requirements: Internal web server/virtual directory support must be compiled in.
callback must be a valid function pointer.

functions.name: UpnpVirtualDir_set_WriteCallback
functions.description: Register the write callback used by the web server to write to virtual directory file handles.
requirements: Internal web server/virtual directory support must be compiled in.
callback must be a valid function pointer.

functions.name: UpnpVirtualDir_set_SeekCallback
functions.description: Register the seek callback used by the web server to reposition virtual directory file handles.
requirements: Internal web server/virtual directory support must be compiled in.
callback must be a valid function pointer; offset and origin semantics as in fseek/lseek; origin is SEEK_SET/SEEK_CUR/SEEK_END.

functions.name: UpnpVirtualDir_set_CloseCallback
functions.description: Register the close callback used by the web server to close virtual directory file handles.
requirements: Internal web server/virtual directory support must be compiled in.
callback must be a valid function pointer.

functions.name: UpnpEnableWebserver
functions.description: Enable (1) or disable (0) the internal web server.
requirements: Internal web server must be compiled in; otherwise returns UPNP_E_NO_WEB_SERVER.
enable must be 0 or 1.

functions.name: UpnpIsWebserverEnabled
functions.description: Return 1 if the internal web server is enabled, 0 otherwise.
requirements: None.

functions.name: UpnpSetHostValidateCallback
functions.description: Set or clear a callback used by the web server to validate HTTP Host header values for incoming requests.
requirements: callback may be NULL to disable validation; otherwise must return UPNP_E_SUCCESS to accept or UPNP_E_BAD_HTTPMSG to reject.
cookie is an opaque pointer passed to the callback.

functions.name: UpnpSetAllowLiteralHostRedirection
functions.description: Enable (non-zero) or disable (zero, default) literal IP redirection handling in the web server.
requirements: enable is an integer flag: 0 disables, non-zero enables.

functions.name: UpnpSetWebServerCorsString
functions.description: Set the global CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header value used by the internal web server.
requirements: Available only if the internal web server is compiled in.
corsString must be a valid string to enable CORS; behavior of NULL not explicitly documented.

functions.name: UpnpAddVirtualDir
functions.signature: UPNP_EXPORT_SPEC int UpnpAddVirtualDir(const char *dirName, const void *cookie, const void **oldcookie);
functions.description: Add a virtual directory mapping; requests under dirName are served via the registered virtual directory callbacks. Associates a cookie with the mapping.
requirements: Internal web server must be compiled in.
dirName must be a valid directory name segment (e.g., "/virtual").
cookie is stored and provided back to callbacks; may be NULL.
oldcookie must be a valid output pointer when updating an existing mapping to receive the previous cookie (or NULL if not present).
Virtual directory callbacks should be set beforehand using UpnpVirtualDir_set_* APIs.

functions.name: UpnpRemoveVirtualDir
functions.description: Remove a previously added virtual directory mapping.
requirements: dirName must be a valid existing virtual directory name added earlier.

functions.name: UpnpRemoveAllVirtualDirs
functions.description: Remove all virtual directory mappings from the internal web server.
requirements: No parameters; effect only if internal web server and virtual directory support are compiled in.

import random
import string
from typing import List

def _rand_ascii(r: random.Random, min_len: int, max_len: int) -> str:
    n = r.randint(min_len, max_len)
    # Mix of visible ASCII plus some spaces and punctuation typical for URLs/MIME/XML
    alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + " -_./:;?,&=+@#[](){}|~^%$!"\
                "\t\r\n"  # allow some whitespace as many APIs accept it
    return ''.join(r.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(n))

def _rand_token(r: random.Random, min_len: int, max_len: int) -> str:
    # XML/attr-safe-ish name: first char letter or '_', rest include [-._0-9A-Za-z]
    first_alph = string.ascii_letters + "_"
    rest_alph = first_alph + string.digits + "-._"
    n = r.randint(min_len, max_len)
    if n <= 0:
        n = 1
    s = r.choice(first_alph)
    s += ''.join(r.choice(rest_alph) for _ in range(n-1))
    return s

def _rand_uuid_like(r: random.Random) -> str:
    # Produce UUID-like SID of length <= 43 (leaving NUL for 44 char buffer) prefixed with uuid:
    hexs = string.hexdigits.lower()
    parts = [
        ''.join(r.choice(hexs[:16]) for _ in range(8)),
        ''.join(r.choice(hexs[:16]) for _ in range(4)),
        ''.join(r.choice(hexs[:16]) for _ in range(4)),
        ''.join(r.choice(hexs[:16]) for _ in range(4)),
        ''.join(r.choice(hexs[:16]) for _ in range(12)),
    ]
    return "uuid:" + "-".join(parts)

def _rand_url(r: random.Random) -> str:
    schemes = ["http", "https", "urn", "file"]
    scheme = r.choice(schemes)
    if scheme in ("http", "https"):
        host = _rand_token(r, 3, 10).lower() + "." + r.choice(["local", "lan", "example.com", "upnp"])
        path = "/" + _rand_token(r, 1, 8)
        if r.random() < 0.5:
            query = "?" + _rand_token(r, 1, 6) + "=" + _rand_token(r, 0, 6)
        else:
            query = ""
        return f"{scheme}://{host}{path}{query}"
    if scheme == "file":
        return "file:///" + _rand_token(r, 3, 10)
    # urn
    ns = r.choice(["schemas-upnp-org:service", "schemas-upnp-org:device", "fuzz"])
    name = _rand_token(r, 3, 12)
    ver = str(r.randint(1, 3))
    return f"urn:{ns}:{name}:{ver}"

def _rand_mime(r: random.Random) -> str:
    typ = r.choice(["text", "application", "image", "audio", "video"])
    sub = _rand_token(r, 3, 10).lower()
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        # with charset parameter
        charset = r.choice(["utf-8", "iso-8859-1", "us-ascii"])
        return f"{typ}/{sub}; charset={charset}"
    return f"{typ}/{sub}"

def _rand_xml_snippet(r: random.Random) -> str:
    tag = _rand_token(r, 1, 8)
    a = _rand_token(r, 1, 6)
    b = _rand_token(r, 1, 6)
    aval = _rand_ascii(r, 0, 12).replace('"', "'")
    bval = _rand_ascii(r, 0, 12).replace('"', "'")
    text = _rand_ascii(r, 0, 16)
    return f"<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>\n<{tag} {a}=\"{aval}\" {b}=\"{bval}\">{text}</{tag}>\n"

def _rand_choice_weighted(r: random.Random) -> str:
    # Choose among common strings used by stubs to maximize valid paths
    choices: List[str] = [
        "",  # allow empty where permitted (some stubs replace with defaults)
        "ssdp:all",
        "upnp:rootdevice",
        "urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:WANIPConnection:1",
        _rand_url(r),
        _rand_url(r),
        _rand_mime(r),
        _rand_uuid_like(r),
        _rand_xml_snippet(r),
        _rand_token(r, 1, 12),
        _rand_ascii(r, 1, 40),
    ]
    return r.choice(choices)

def _make_corpus(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    # Build a corpus with several null-terminated C strings concatenated.
    # The harness will slice these for FUZZ_PARAM_STR/FILENAME; keep under 4096.
    parts: List[bytes] = []
    total = 0

    # Prepend a few very typical values to drive success paths
    preset = [
        b"urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:Svc:1\x00",
        b"/root\x00",
        b"*\x00",
        b"A\x00",
    ]
    for p in preset:
        parts.append(p)
        total += len(p)

    # Generate a mix of URLs, MIME types, XML snippets, tokens, and random ascii
    count = r.randint(10, 25)
    for _ in range(count):
        s = _rand_choice_weighted(r)
        # Ensure CDATA-safe by breaking "]]>" if present to keep ixml CDATA creation valid
        s = s.replace("]]>", "]]_>")
        # Bound each string length to reasonable size
        if len(s) > 512:
            s = s[:512]
        b = s.encode('utf-8', errors='replace') + b"\x00"
        if total + len(b) > 4000:
            break
        parts.append(b)
        total += len(b)

    return b"".join(parts)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    return _make_corpus(seed)

# This generator targets stubs that consume raw byte buffers via FUZZ_PARAM_STR

def gen_sid(r: random.Random) -> str:
    # Typical SID format: uuid:xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
    hexs = '0123456789abcdef'
    def block(n: int) -> str:
        return ''.join(r.choice(hexs) for _ in range(n))
    return 'uuid:' + '-'.join([
        block(8), block(4), block(4), block(4), block(12)
    ])

def gen_url(r: random.Random) -> str:
    schemes = ['http', 'https']
    hosts = ['device', 'service', 'cp', 'media', 'upnp', 'gateway', 'router']
    tlds = ['local', 'lan', 'home', 'example.com']
    path_parts = ['desc.xml', 'event', 'control', 'service', 'rootDesc.xml', 'scpd.xml']
    scheme = rand_choice(r, schemes)
    host = rand_choice(r, hosts)
    tld = rand_choice(r, tlds)
    port = '' if r.random() < 0.6 else f":{r.randrange(80, 9000)}"
    path = '/' + '/'.join(p for p in [rand_choice(r, path_parts)] if p)
    return f"{scheme}://{host}.{tld}{port}{path}"

    # urn:schemas-upnp-org:device:DeviceType:ver

def gen_http_date(r: random.Random) -> str:

    wd = rand_choice(r, wdays)
    d = r.randrange(1, 29)
    mo = rand_choice(r, months)
    y = r.randrange(2000, 2038)
    hh = r.randrange(0,24)
    mm = r.randrange(0,60)
    ss = r.randrange(0,60)

def build_payload(r: random.Random, target_size: int) -> bytes:

    lines = [
        f"SID: {gen_sid(r)}",
        f"LOCATION: {gen_url(r)}",
        f"DEVICEID: {gen_udn(r)}",
        f"DEVICETYPE: {gen_device_type(r)}",
        f"SERVICETYPE: {gen_service_type(r)}",

        f"ACTION: {gen_action_name(r)}",
        f"SERVICEID: {gen_service_type(r)}",
        f"UDN: {gen_udn(r)}",
        f"CTRLURL: {gen_url(r)}",
        f"STATEVARNAME: Volume",
        f"ERRSTR: Invalid Arguments",
    ]

    # Randomly shuffle some lines for variety
    r.shuffle(lines)

    # Add lines to parts
    for ln in lines:
        parts.append((ln + "\r\n").encode('utf-8'))
        if sum(len(p) for p in parts) > target_size * 3 // 4:

    xml_frag = (

        "s:encodingStyle=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/encoding/\">"
        "<s:Body><u:Action xmlns:u=\"urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:AVTransport:1\">"
        "<InstanceID>0</InstanceID><Speed>1</Speed></u:Action></s:Body></s:Envelope>"
    ).encode('utf-8')
    parts.append(xml_frag + b"\r\n")

    # Insert binary blobs to exercise bounded reads with non-text bytes
    def rand_bytes(n: int) -> bytes:
        return bytes(r.randrange(0, 256) for _ in range(n))

    # A few binary chunks of varying sizes
    for _ in range(r.randrange(2, 5)):
        chunk_len = r.randrange(8, 64)

    if r.random() < 0.7:

        parts.append(s)

    buf = b''.join(parts)

        buf = buf[:target_size]

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    # Choose a target size between 64 and 2048, but never exceeding MAX_SIZE
    target = min(MAX_SIZE, r.randrange(64, 2049))

# Generator for well-formed XML documents tailored to exercise common XML features
# expected by ixmlLoadDocument/ixmlLoadDocumentEx. It returns bytes suitable to
# be written to a fuzz corpus file referenced by FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME().

XML_DECL_TEMPLATES = [
    '<?xml version="1.0"?>',
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>',
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" standalone="yes"?>',
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>',
]

NAMESPACES = [
    ("", ""),  # no namespace
    ("h", "http://www.w3.org/TR/html4/"),
    ("f", "https://example.com/fns"),
    ("x", "urn:schemas-upnp-org:device-1-0"),
]

# Some element/attribute names including UPnP-ish names to hit library code paths
ELEM_NAMES = [
    "root", "device", "service", "specVersion", "URLBase", "displayName",
    "friendlyName", "manufacturer", "modelName", "UDN", "serviceList",
    "serviceType", "serviceId", "SCPDURL", "controlURL", "eventSubURL",
    "item", "container", "icon", "presentationURL", "X", "Y", "Z"
]

ATTR_NAMES = [
    "id", "name", "type", "value", "version", "major", "minor",
    "xmlns", "encodingStyle", "class", "modelNumber", "protocolInfo",
]

# Some character data variants
TEXT_SNIPPETS = [
    "Hello World",
    "Sample text with entities: & < > " ©",
    "UPnP Test",
    "路径/パス/مسار",
    "Line1\nLine2\r\nLine3",
]

CDATA_SNIPPETS = [
    "<escaped> & not parsed </escaped>",
    "Some CDATA with ]]> edge split",
    "{\"json\":true}",
]

COMMENTS = [
    "a comment", "UPnP device description", "unicode ✓", "edge -- dash"
]

PI_TARGETS = ["xml-stylesheet", "processing", "ups"]
PI_DATA = [
    'type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"',
    'cmd="rebuild-cache"',
    'note="test"',
]

DOCTYPES = [
    "<!DOCTYPE root>",
    "<!DOCTYPE root SYSTEM \"about:legacy-compat\">",
    "<!DOCTYPE root [<!ELEMENT root ANY>]>",
]

def _rand_name(rng: random.Random, with_ns: Tuple[str, str]) -> str:
    prefix, _ = with_ns
    base = rng.choice(ELEM_NAMES)
    if prefix:
        return f"{prefix}:{base}"
    return base

def _rand_attr_name(rng: random.Random, with_ns: Tuple[str, str]) -> str:
    prefix, _ = with_ns
    base = rng.choice(ATTR_NAMES)
    if prefix and rng.random() < 0.3:
        return f"{prefix}:{base}"
    return base

def _attrs(rng: random.Random, with_ns: Tuple[str, str]) -> str:
    n = rng.randint(0, 4)
    pairs = []
    for _ in range(n):
        k = _rand_attr_name(rng, with_ns)
        # Avoid duplicate attribute names within the same element
        if any(k == existing.split('=')[0].strip() for existing in pairs):
            continue
        v = rng.choice([
            "1", "true", "false", "text", "urn:upnp-org:serviceId:svc",
            "uuid:12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab", "http://example.com"
        ])
        pairs.append(f"{k}=\"{v}\"")
    return (" " + " ".join(pairs)) if pairs else ""

def _element_with_content(rng: random.Random, with_ns: Tuple[str, str], depth: int) -> str:
    name = _rand_name(rng, with_ns)
    # Ensure xmlns declaration at the top-most or randomly deeper
    nsdecl = ""
    prefix, uri = with_ns
    if uri and (depth == 0 or rng.random() < 0.25):
        if prefix:
            nsdecl = f" xmlns:{prefix}=\"{uri}\""
        else:
            nsdecl = f" xmlns=\"{uri}\""
    attrs = _attrs(rng, with_ns)

    # Choose content kind
    kind = rng.choices(
        population=["children", "text", "cdata", "mixed", "empty"],
        weights=[0.35, 0.25, 0.15, 0.2, 0.05],
        k=1,
    )[0]

    if kind == "empty":
        return f"<{name}{nsdecl}{attrs}/>"

    inner: List[str] = []

    # Optional comment before content
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        inner.append(f"<!-- {rng.choice(COMMENTS)} -->")

    if kind in ("text", "mixed"):
        inner.append(rng.choice(TEXT_SNIPPETS))

    if kind in ("cdata", "mixed"):
        c = rng.choice(CDATA_SNIPPETS)
        # Ensure CDATA does not contain ']]>' verbatim
        c = c.replace("]]>", "]]\u003E")
        inner.append(f"<![CDATA[{c}]]>")

    if kind in ("children", "mixed"):
        child_count = 0 if depth > 3 else rng.randint(1, 3)
        for _ in range(child_count):
            # Occasionally switch namespace on child
            with_child_ns = with_ns
            if rng.random() < 0.3:
                with_child_ns = rng.choice(NAMESPACES)
            inner.append(_element_with_content(rng, with_child_ns, depth + 1))

    return f"<{name}{nsdecl}{attrs}>" + "".join(inner) + f"</{name}>"

def _prolog(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    parts = []
    parts.append(rng.choice(XML_DECL_TEMPLATES))
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        parts.append(rng.choice(DOCTYPES))
    # Optional processing instruction
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        parts.append(f"<?{rng.choice(PI_TARGETS)} {rng.choice(PI_DATA)}?>")
    # Optional comment at top
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        parts.append(f"<!-- {rng.choice(COMMENTS)} -->")
    return "".join(parts)

def _build_xml(rng: random.Random, target_bytes: int) -> str:
    # Choose a root namespace
    root_ns = rng.choice(NAMESPACES)
    root = _element_with_content(rng, root_ns, 0)
    xml = _prolog(rng) + root
    # Optionally add a trailing comment or PI to vary parse states
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        xml += f"<!-- tail {rng.choice(COMMENTS)} -->"
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        xml += f"<?{rng.choice(PI_TARGETS)} {rng.choice(PI_DATA)}?>"

    # Ensure size under limit; if too large, trim safe areas (comments/text)
    if len(xml.encode('utf-8')) > target_bytes:
        # crude trimming: remove some comments/text content first
        xml = xml[:target_bytes]
        # try to end cleanly by appending a closing comment if needed
        if not xml.strip().endswith('>'):
            xml += '>'
    return xml

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Aim for varied sizes up to ~3KB to stay under 4096 bytes overall
    target = rng.randrange(256, 3072)
    xml = _build_xml(rng, target)
    # Ensure it looks like a UPnP device description sometimes to hit code paths
    if rng.random() < 0.35:
        # Minimal valid UPnP-like description document
        upnp = (
            '<?xml version="1.0"?>'
            '<root xmlns="urn:schemas-upnp-org:device-1-0">'
            '<specVersion><major>1</major><minor>0</minor></specVersion>'
            '<device>'
            '<deviceType>urn:schemas-upnp-org:device:Basic:1</deviceType>'
            '<friendlyName>FuzzDevice</friendlyName>'
            '<manufacturer>FuzzCo</manufacturer>'
            '<modelName>ModelX</modelName>'
            '<UDN>uuid:12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab</UDN>'
            '<serviceList>'
            '<service>'
            '<serviceType>urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:SwitchPower:1</serviceType>'
            '<serviceId>urn:upnp-org:serviceId:SwitchPower1</serviceId>'
            '<SCPDURL>/service/scpd.xml</SCPDURL>'
            '<controlURL>/service/control</controlURL>'
            '<eventSubURL>/service/event</eventSubURL>'
            '</service>'
            '</serviceList>'
            '</device>'
            '</root>'
        )
        # Mix with previously generated content to keep variability while valid
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            xml = upnp
        else:
            xml = _prolog(rng) + upnp
    data = xml.encode('utf-8')
    # Final size guard
    if len(data) > 4096:
        data = data[:4096]
    return data

# Generator for URN strings suitable for UPnP service/device types and HTTP URLs for action endpoints.
# The fuzzer stubs call FUZZ_PARAM_STR twice:
#  - actionUrl: should look like a reachable-ish HTTP(S) URL or a relative control URL
#  - serviceType: should be a valid UPnP URN such as urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:WANIPConnection:1
# We will build a buffer that concatenates two NUL-terminated strings: actionUrl + '\0' + serviceType + '\0'.
# Harnesses typically split or consume these as independent strings.

_SCHEMAS = [
    ("upnp-org", [
        ("service", [
            "WANIPConnection", "WANPPPConnection", "Layer3Forwarding", "AVTransport",
            "RenderingControl", "ConnectionManager", "ContentDirectory", "SwitchPower",
            "BinaryLight", "Dimming"
        ]),
        ("device", [
            "InternetGatewayDevice", "WANDevice", "WANConnectionDevice", "MediaServer",
            "MediaRenderer", "BasicDevice"
        ]),
    ]),
    ("microsoft-com", [
        ("service", ["X_MS_MediaReceiverRegistrar", "X_MS_ConnectionManager"]),
        ("device", ["X_MS_MediaReceiver"]),
    ]),
    ("schemas", [  # vendor style catch-all
        ("service", ["FooService", "BarService", "BazService"]),
        ("device", ["FooDevice", "BarDevice"]),
    ])
]

_VERSIONS = ["1", "2", "3", "1-0", "2-0"]

_PATHS = [
    "/upnp/control/WANIPConn1",
    "/upnp/control/WANPPPConn1",
    "/ctl/AVTransport",
    "/ctl/RenderingControl",
    "/ctl/ConnectionManager",
    "/upnp/control/ContentDir",
    "/upnp/control/SwitchPower1",
]

_HOSTS = [
    "192.168.1.1", "192.168.0.1", "10.0.0.1", "router.local", "device.local",
    "[fe80::1]", "[::1]", "example.com"
]

_SCHEMES = ["http", "https"]

# Sometimes control URL may be relative as found in UPnP descriptions
_RELATIVE_PATHS = [
    "ctl/AVTransport", "ctl/RenderingControl", "upnp/control/WANIPConn1", "cm/ctl", "igd/wanip"
]

def _random_choice_weighted(rng: random.Random, items_with_w):
    total = sum(w for _, w in items_with_w)
    pick = rng.uniform(0, total)
    upto = 0.0
    for item, w in items_with_w:
        if upto + w >= pick:
            return item
        upto += w
    return items_with_w[-1][0]

def build_service_urn(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:WANIPConnection:1
    vendor, groups = rng.choice(_SCHEMAS)
    kind, names = rng.choice(groups)
    name = rng.choice(names)
    # Occasionally add a subtype suffix common in some vendors
    if rng.random() < 0.15:
        suffix = rng.choice([".com", ".vendor", ".v2", ".alt"])  # not strictly standard but accepted by some stacks
        name = name + suffix
    version = rng.choice(_VERSIONS)
    return f"urn:schemas-{vendor}:{kind}:{name}:{version}"

def build_device_urn(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    vendor, groups = rng.choice(_SCHEMAS)
    # force device
    dev_names = None
    for kind, names in groups:
        if kind == "device":
            dev_names = names
            break
    if not dev_names:
        dev_names = ["BasicDevice"]
    name = rng.choice(dev_names)
    version = rng.choice(_VERSIONS)
    return f"urn:schemas-{vendor}:device:{name}:{version}"

def build_action_url(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Mix absolute URLs and relative control URLs
    choice = _random_choice_weighted(rng, [("abs", 0.75), ("rel", 0.25)])
    if choice == "rel":
        base = rng.choice(_RELATIVE_PATHS)
        if not base.startswith("/"):
            return base
        return base.lstrip("/")
    scheme = rng.choice(_SCHEMES)
    host = rng.choice(_HOSTS)
    # Optionally add port
    port = ""
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        portnum = rng.choice([80, 1400, 49152, 49153, 5000, 8080])
        port = f":{portnum}"
    path = rng.choice(_PATHS)
    # Optionally add query
    query = ""
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        params = [
            ("sid", "uuid:%08x-%04x-%04x-%04x-%012x" % (
                rng.getrandbits(32), rng.getrandbits(16), rng.getrandbits(16), rng.getrandbits(16), rng.getrandbits(48))),
            ("x", str(rng.randint(0, 5))),
        ]
        qparts = [f"{k}={v}" for k, v in params[: rng.randint(1, len(params))]]
        query = "?" + "&".join(qparts)
    return f"{scheme}://{host}{port}{path}{query}"

def build_service_type(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Prefer service URNs but sometimes return device URNs to exercise error paths that are still valid strings
    if rng.random() < 0.8:
        return build_service_urn(rng)
    return build_device_urn(rng)

def pack_c_strings(*strings: str) -> bytes:
    # Join as NUL-terminated C strings
    b = bytearray()
    for s in strings:
        b.extend(s.encode('utf-8'))
        b.append(0)
    return bytes(b)

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Build multiple candidate pairs and pick one with mild variability to keep seeded randomness
    builders = [
        lambda r: (build_action_url(r), build_service_type(r)),
        lambda r: ("/upnp/control", build_service_urn(r)),
        lambda r: ("http://%s:%d/%s" % (
            rng.choice(["192.168.1.100", "10.1.1.1", "device.local"]),
            rng.choice([80, 1400, 5000, 8080]),
            rng.choice(["ctl", "upnp/control", "service"]) ), build_service_urn(r)),
        lambda r: ("/ctl/ConnectionManager", "urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:ConnectionManager:1"),
        lambda r: ("http://example.com:1400/MediaRenderer/AVTransport/Control", "urn:schemas-upnp-org:service:AVTransport:1"),
    ]
    action_url, service_type = rng.choice(builders)(rng)

    # Occasionally vary case or add harmless whitespace around URN (some stacks trim); but keep valid
    if rng.random() < 0.1:
        service_type = service_type.strip()
    if rng.random() < 0.1:
        # lower or upper randomly for vendor segments (URNs are case-sensitive in general; keep schemas in lowercase)
        parts = service_type.split(":")
        if len(parts) >= 5:
            # Only vary the name segment
            name = parts[3]
            parts[3] = ''.join(rng.choice([c.lower(), c.upper()]) for c in name)
            service_type = ":".join(parts)

    buf = pack_c_strings(action_url, service_type)
    # Ensure size limit
    return buf[:4096]

from typing import List

# Data type: alphanumeric identifier
# - Null-terminated C string expected by stubs via FUZZ_PARAM_STR()
# - Valid characters: letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot
# - Often used as: XML tag names, attribute names, UPnP IDs, service/variable names
# - Some contexts want prefixes like uuid: or urn:schemas-upnp-org
# - The fuzzer stubs also construct XML documents from provided strings, so
#   we must avoid characters that would break XML syntax and keep names starting
#   with a letter or underscore when used as tag names.
# - Keep total buffer size <= 4096 bytes.

SAFE_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_- .:/#"
IDENT_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_- .:/#"
NAME_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_-.:"  # For XML names, avoid space and slash inside names
NAME_START = string.ascii_letters + "_"  # XML name start


def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.randrange(0, 256) for _ in range(n))


def _rand_ident(rng: random.Random, min_len: int = 1, max_len: int = 24) -> str:
    L = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    start = rng.choice(NAME_START)
    rest = ''.join(rng.choice(NAME_CHARS) for _ in range(max(0, L - 1)))
    return start + rest


def _rand_value(rng: random.Random, min_len: int = 0, max_len: int = 48) -> str:
    # For values inserted as XML text or attribute values; sanitize control chars
    L = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    s = ''.join(rng.choice(SAFE_CHARS) for _ in range(L))
    # Trim leading/trailing spaces occasionally
    if L > 0 and rng.random() < 0.3:
        s = s.strip()
    return s


def _uuid_like(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Generate a UUID-like SID string suitable for Upnp_SID (<= 43 chars after 'uuid:')
    hexs = '0123456789abcdef'
    parts = [
        ''.join(rng.choice(hexs) for _ in range(8)),
        ''.join(rng.choice(hexs) for _ in range(4)),
        ''.join(rng.choice(hexs) for _ in range(4)),
        ''.join(rng.choice(hexs) for _ in range(4)),
        ''.join(rng.choice(hexs) for _ in range(12)),
    ]
    sid = 'uuid:' + '-'.join(parts)
    # Ensure <= 43 characters to fit in 44 including NUL in stub
    return sid[:43]


def _service_id(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Common UPnP service ID pattern
    domain = 'upnp-org' if rng.random() < 0.5 else _rand_ident(rng, 3, 12).lower()
    svc = _rand_ident(rng, 3, 16)
    ver = str(rng.randint(1, 3))
    return f"urn:schemas-{domain}:service:{svc}:{ver}"


def _device_udn(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Typical device UDN format: uuid:xxxxxxxx-....
    return _uuid_like(rng)


def _action_url(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Reasonable control/action URL; the SDK may parse/validate
    host = _rand_ident(rng, 3, 10).lower()
    tld = rng.choice(['com', 'net', 'org', 'local'])
    path = '/upnp/control/' + _rand_ident(rng, 3, 12)
    return f"http://{host}.{tld}{path}"


def _xml_identifier(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # For XML tag/attr names
    return _rand_ident(rng, 1, 12)


def _assemble_cstring_block(parts: List[str]) -> bytes:
    # Join multiple null-terminated C strings into one buffer
    out = bytearray()
    for s in parts:
        out += s.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore') + b"\x00"
    return bytes(out)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # We need to feed FUZZ_PARAM_STR across several stubs:
    # - UpnpGetServiceVarStatus: actionUrl, varName
    # - UpnpAcceptSubscription/Notify: devID, servID, varNames[i], newVals[i], SID base
    # - Upnp*Ext: value to embed in XML
    # - IXML builders: baseTag fuzz, tag, attribute values
    # Construct a sequence of useful strings in expected order variety.

    # Core identifiers/values
    action_url = _action_url(rng)
    var_name = _xml_identifier(rng)

    dev_id = _device_udn(rng)
    serv_id = _service_id(rng)

    # Variable sets (up to 3 pairs as stubs cap at %4)
    count = rng.randint(0, 3)
    var_names = [_xml_identifier(rng) for _ in range(count)]
    new_vals = [_rand_value(rng, 0, 32) for _ in range(count)]

    # For XML propertyset value
    xml_val = _rand_value(rng, 0, 40)

    # For IXML NodeList: fuzz appended to baseTag
    base_fuzz = _rand_value(rng, 0, 16).replace(' ', '')

    # For NamedNodeMap: attribute values and tag fuzz
    tag_fuzz = _rand_value(rng, 0, 12).replace(' ', '')
    aval = _rand_value(rng, 0, 12)
    bval = _rand_value(rng, 0, 12)

    # Additional SIDs to be used when stubs request another FUZZ_PARAM_STR for SID base
    extra_sid = _uuid_like(rng)

    # Collect in an order that provides reasonable defaults regardless of stub call patterns.
    parts: List[str] = []

    # UpnpGetServiceVarStatus
    parts.append(action_url)
    parts.append(var_name)

    # UpnpAcceptSubscription / UpnpNotify
    parts.append(dev_id)
    parts.append(serv_id)
    for name, val in zip(var_names, new_vals):
        parts.append(name)
        parts.append(val)

    # SID-like strings for stubs that prepend "uuid:" themselves
    parts.append(extra_sid.replace('uuid:', ''))

    # Ext variants need values embedded in XML
    parts.append(xml_val)

    # IXML NodeList baseTag fuzz
    parts.append(base_fuzz)

    # IXML NamedNodeMap tag fuzz and attribute values
    parts.append(tag_fuzz)
    parts.append(aval)
    parts.append(bval)

    # Add a few more generic identifiers to be consumed if needed
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 5)):
        parts.append(_xml_identifier(rng))
        parts.append(_rand_value(rng, 0, 24))

    # Ensure buffer size limit; truncate gracefully by limiting number of parts
    buf = _assemble_cstring_block(parts)
    if len(buf) > 4096:
        # If too large, progressively drop tail parts
        while len(buf) > 4096 and parts:
            parts.pop()
            buf = _assemble_cstring_block(parts)
    return buf
